findings.claim: Q3 2026 revenue was a record $82.7 million, up 171% year over year and 20% sequentially, on a 216% YoY increase in cube shipments across 10 projects.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $82.7 Million, Up 171% Year Over Year

findings.claim: Q3 2026 gross margin remained deeply negative at -53% (gross loss $44.2M) and adjusted EBITDA loss was $63.8M (-77% margin); reported net income of $125.0M was primarily non-cash mark-to-market gains on warrants and debt.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $82.7 Million

findings.claim: Eos expects full-year 2026 revenue in the lower half of its $300-$350 million range ($300-$325M), implying Q4 revenue of $92-$117M, and guides Q4 adjusted gross margin to -25% to -20%.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy (EOSE) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Backlog was $765 million (3.2 GWh) at Sept 30, 2026, up 19% YoY but down 5% from $807M in Q2 as shipments exceeded bookings; commercial pipeline was $24.9 billion with 3.5 GWh of late-stage opportunities.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy (EOSE) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Related-party revenue represented 83% of Q3 2026 quarterly volume, including projects acquired by Frontier Power USA (FPUSA), a JV in which Eos holds ~36%; management expects this share to decline in Q4.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy (EOSE) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Heavy reliance on a JV that Eos itself funded ($112.6M contribution) for most quarterly volume raises questions about the independence and quality of demand until third-party mix normalizes.
findings.source_title: Form 8-K for EOS Energy Enterprises INC filed 08/06/2026

findings.claim: Line 2 reached first-pass yield parity with Line 1 within three months; Thorn Hill moved to 24-hour operations in October. Eos is consolidating manufacturing into Thorn Hill, temporarily reducing Q4 capacity, with Line 1 targeted to return to production near end of Q1 2027.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises (EOSE) Investor Relations, Earnings Summary & Outlook

findings.claim: Eos announced a project with MN8 Energy to deliver 10 MW/100 MWh of Z3 zinc-based long-duration storage in West Virginia serving Google's data centers.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $82.7 Million

findings.claim: Eos received an $87 million first advance under the second tranche of its DOE Loan Programs Office loan; through Sept 30, 2026 it had drawn ~$178.0 million under the DOE facility.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Form 10-Q for quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: In November 2025 Eos issued $600 million of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 (initial conversion price ~$16.29/share); it also has May 2025 convertible notes with an initial conversion price of ~$5.10/share.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Form 10-Q for quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: To fund its FPUSA contribution, Eos sold 13,683,634 shares plus 6,004,378 warrants ($5.481 strike) to Hudson Bay for ~$75M (June 30, 2026) and closed a rights offering of 6,885,218 shares and 3,019,242 warrants for ~$37.7M gross (Aug 3, 2026); these triggered anti-dilution adjustments increasing shares issuable on Series B preferred conversion by ~15.1 million.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Form 10-Q for quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act preserved Section 45X manufacturing credits for battery components through 2029 (then phasing down to 2032) and storage ITCs while adding prohibited-foreign-entity restrictions; Eos claims >90% domestic content and a FEOC-compliant supply chain.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

findings.claim: Total cash including restricted cash was $344.1 million ($271.1M unrestricted) at Sept 30, 2026; the company was in compliance with its $15M minimum-liquidity covenant.
findings.source_title: Eos Energy Enterprises Form 10-Q for quarter ended September 30, 2026

upcoming_catalysts.event: Q4 2026 results vs. guidance of $92-$117M revenue and -25% to -20% adjusted gross margin
Relocated/upgraded Line 1 returns to production at Thorn Hill
Conversion of 3.5 GWh late-stage pipeline (financing/contract negotiations) into backlog

policy_links.policy: IRC Section 45X advanced manufacturing production tax credit (preserved by OBBBA, $35/kWh cells + $10/kWh modules + 10% electrode active materials through 2029)
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: Transferable production tax credits monetized for cash

policy_links.policy: OBBBA prohibited foreign entity (FEOC) restrictions on storage ITC (48E) and 45X credits
policy_links.bottleneck: Chinese-dominated battery supply chain becomes ineligible for credits
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: Customers seeking ITC eligibility favor FEOC-compliant domestic suppliers like Eos

policy_links.policy: DOE Loan Programs Office loan facility (multi-tranche, ~$178M drawn through Q3 2026)

key_risks.risk: Persistently negative gross margins and large adjusted EBITDA losses ($63.8M in Q3 2026)
Revenue concentration in related party (FPUSA JV): 83% of Q3 volume
Manufacturing consolidation reduces Q4 capacity and may shift shipment timing; guidance already cut to lower half of range
Significant convertible debt, warrants and preferred conversion shares create dilution overhang and fair-value earnings volatility
Backlog declined sequentially (5%) as bookings lagged shipments; late-stage pipeline depends on project financing

dilution_events_last_12m.description: Registered direct offering to Hudson Bay: 13,683,634 shares + 6,004,378 warrants (exercise $5.481), ~$75M
Rights offering closed: 6,885,218 shares + 3,019,242 warrants ($5.481), ~$37.7M gross
Anti-dilution adjustments increased common shares issuable on Series B-1 to B-4 preferred conversion by ~15.1M shares

notes: FY2025 10-K states management concluded there is no longer substantial doubt about going concern after 2025 capital raises; no going-concern language found in the Q3 2026 10-Q. The Nov 2025 convertible note 8-K date is from the investor-site filename ('filed 11/24/2025'). Q4 2026 earnings date not yet announced.
